Crossword Solver

This tool finds words that fit the letters you know. It does not read clues.

Everything runs in your browser; nothing you type is uploaded.

Matching words will show up here.

This tool finds words that fit the letters you know. It does not read clues. Words come from the ENABLE word list. Not an official tournament word list. Offensive words are hidden.

2 to 28 letters. For 4 or more letters, at least one letter must be filled in. The list shows 300 words at a time.

How to use

  1. Type a pattern into "Pattern". Use a letter you know, and ? or _ or . or * for a blank.

  2. Or set "Length" and type into the boxes.

  3. Press "Find words". Click a word to copy it, or press "Copy all". Press "Show more" for the next words.

Example

Jordan knows a 3-letter answer starts with C and ends with T, and types C?T.

BeforeAfter
 
C?T
cat, cot, cut

FAQ

Does this read the clue sentence?

No. This tool finds words that fit the letters you know. It does not read clues.

What can I type for a blank?

Use ?, _, ., or *. C?T, c_t, and c.t all look for the same three-letter words.

Why are common words first?

Everyday words are listed before rare ones. The list is ENABLE, not a tournament list.

What if nothing is found?

Change a letter or turn one box into ?. If the pattern is longer than 28 letters, there is no word that long.

Why is a word missing?

Offensive words are hidden. The result says how many were hidden.
